text: This course, assuming it to lend lustre to individual citizens, is plainly to the disadvantage of the community, which has reason to hope more from, and to trust more to, the citizen who descends from a high office to fill a lower, than him who rises from a low office to fill a high one.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
